heading: Recall to active duty during war or national emergency
lead: In time of war or national emergency, the Secretary may order any regular officer on the retired list to active duty.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 331 of this title as this section.

notes.heading: Delegation of Authority
notes.text: For delegation of authority under this section, as invoked by section 2 of Ex. Ord. No. 13223, Sept. 14, 2001, 66 F.R. 48201, to Secretary of Homeland Security when Coast Guard is not serving as part of Navy, see section 5 of Ex. Ord. No. 13223, set out as a note under section 12302 of Title 10, Armed Forces.
